bio: Hilton Garden Inn Bristol is situated in the heart of the modern business district, perfectly positioned for exploring all the city and West Country have to offer.  Tuck into a tempting Afternoon Tea served in the stylish Recess, or outdoor terrace while enjoying the stunning views of Temple Gardens.  You can enjoy an array of finger sandwiches which may include filling such as cheddar and chutney or egg & mayonnaise, scones are served with Cornish clotted cream and jam, followed by a selection of delicious cakes. If you wish to make the occasion extra special, why not add a glass of prosecco?
